description: Admin UI for managing mcp_exemptions records on port 8790. Reads from mcp_exemptions via registry_api or direct write_service query. Provides create/expiry-view/revoke operations. Each admin-write action (create, revoke, extend) must insert a row in audit_log per spec section 7. Table columns: mcp_server_id, exemption_reason, valid_until, granted_by. Binds localhost only.
